title: षष्टितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Karna, with the Kurus in flight, goes against the Panchalas, and Satyaki cuts down the arrows that Karna sends against Bhima. Karna wounds Bhima in the fight and the duel continues.
summary.kn: ಕುರುಗಳು ಓಡುತ್ತಿರಲು ಕರ್ಣ ಪಾಂಚಾಲರ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಮನತ್ತ ಕರ್ಣ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದ ಬಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕರ್ಣ ಭೀಮನನ್ನು ಗಾಯಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ದ್ವಂದ್ವ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: कुरुओं के भागने पर कर्ण पाञ्चालों पर चढ़ता है, और सात्यकि भीम की ओर कर्ण के भेजे बाण काट देता है। कर्ण भीम को घायल करता है और द्वन्द्व चलता है।
summary.te: కురువులు పారిపోతుండగా కర్ణుడు పాంచాలులపైకి వెళతాడు; భీమునిపై కర్ణుడు వేసిన బాణాలను సాత్యకి ఛేదిస్తాడు. కర్ణుడు భీమును గాయపరుస్తాడు; ద్వంద్వం కొనసాగుతుంది.
summary.ta: குருக்கள் ஓட, கர்ணன் பாஞ்சாலரைத் தாக்க, பீமனை நோக்கிக் கர்ணன் எய்த அம்புகளைச் சாத்யகி வெட்டுகிறான். கர்ணன் பீமனைக் காயப்படுத்த, தனிப்போர் தொடர்கிறது.
summary.ml: കൗരവർ ഓടിപ്പോകുമ്പോൾ കർണ്ണൻ പാഞ്ചാലരെ നേരിടാൻ പോകുന്നു; ഭീമനുനേരെ കർണ്ണൻ അയക്കുന്ന അമ്പുകൾ സാത്യകി മുറിച്ചുകളയുന്നു. യുദ്ധത്തിൽ കർണ്ണൻ ഭീമനെ മുറിവേൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു; ദ്വന്ദ്വയുദ്ധം തുടരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.60; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततः कर्णः कुरुषु प्रद्रुतेषु
वरूथिना श्वेतहयेन राजन् ।
पाञ्चालपुत्रान्व्यधमत्सूतपुत्रो
महेषुभिर्वात इवाभ्रसंघान् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, as the Kurus fled, Karna the charioteer's son, in his armored chariot drawn by white horses, scattered the sons of the Panchalas with his great arrows, as the wind scatters masses of cloud.

verses.text:
सूतं रथादञ्जलिकेन पात्य
जघान चाश्वाञ्जनमेजयस्य ।
शतानीकं सुतसोमं च भल्लै-
रवाकिरद्धनुषी चाप्यकृन्तत् ॥

meaning.en: With an arrow of the anjalika kind he threw the charioteer of Janamejaya from his chariot and killed his horses; he showered Shatanika and Sutasoma with broad-headed arrows and cut their bows too.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नं निर्बिभेदाथ षड्भि-
र्जघान चाश्वं दक्षिणं तस्य संख्ये ।
हत्वा चाश्वान्सात्यकेः सूतपुत्रः
कैकेयपुत्रं न्यवधीद्विशोकम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna pierced Dhrishtadyumna with six arrows and killed his right-hand horse in the fight; having killed Satyaki's horses, the charioteer's son also slew Vishoka, a son of the Kaikeya king.

verses.text:
तमभ्यधावन्निहते कुमारे
कैकेयसेनापतिरुग्रधन्वा ।
शरैर्विभिन्नं भृशमुग्रवेगैः
कर्णात्मजं सोऽभ्यहनत्सुषेणम् ॥

meaning.en: When the young prince was slain, Ugradhanva, the Kaikeya commander, rushed at Karna, and with fierce, swift arrows struck Karna's son Sushena, wounding him badly.

verses.text:
तस्यार्धचन्द्रैस्त्रिभिरुच्चकर्त
प्रसह्य बाहू च शिरश्च कर्णः ।
स स्यन्दनाद्गामपतद्गतासुः
परश्वधैः शाल इवावरुग्णः ॥

meaning.en: Karna forcibly cut off Ugradhanva's two arms and his head with three crescent-headed arrows, and he fell lifeless from his chariot to the ground, like a sal tree felled by axes.

verses.text:
हताश्वमञ्जोगतिभिः सुषेणः
शिनिप्रवीरं निशितैः पृषत्कैः ।
प्रच्छाद्य नृत्यन्निव सौतिपुत्रः
शैनेयबाणाभिहतः पपात ॥

meaning.en: Sushena, whose horses had been killed, covered the hero of the Sini line with sharp arrows, seeming to dance, but was struck by Satyaki's arrows and fell.

verses.text:
पुत्रे हते क्रोधपरीतचेताः
कर्णः शिनीनामृषभं जिघांसुः ।
हतोऽसि शैनेय इति ब्रुवन्स
व्यवासृजद्बाणममित्रसाहम् ॥

meaning.en: When his son was slain, Karna, his mind seized by anger and wishing to kill the bull of the Sinis, cried, "You are dead, Shaineya!" and loosed an arrow that overcame foes.

verses.text:
स तस्य चिच्छेद शरं शिखण्डी
त्रिभिस्त्रिभिश्च प्रतुतोद कर्णम् ।
शिखण्डिनः कार्मुकं स ध्वजं च
च्छित्त्वा शराभ्यामहनत्सुजातम् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi cut that arrow of his and wounded Karna with three arrows after three more; Karna cut Shikhandi's bow and banner and killed Sujata with two arrows.

verses.text:
शिखण्डिनं षड्भिरविध्यदुग्रो
दान्तो धार्ष्टद्युम्नशिरश्चकर्त ।
अथाभिनत्सुतसोमं शरेण
स संशितेनाधिरथिर्महात्मा ॥

meaning.en: The fierce, self-controlled Karna pierced Shikhandi with six arrows and cut off the head of Dhrishtadyumna's son, and then the great-souled son of Adhiratha struck Sutasoma with a keen arrow.

verses.text:
अथाक्रन्दे तुमुले वर्तमाने
धार्ष्टद्युम्ने निहते तत्र कृष्णः ।
अपाञ्चाल्यं क्रियते याहि पार्थ
कर्णं जहीत्यब्रवीद्राजसिंह ॥

meaning.en: Then, as a tumult of cries arose and Dhrishtadyumna's son lay dead there, Krishna said, "O lion among kings, the Panchalas are being wiped out; go, Partha, and kill Karna."

verses.text:
ततः प्रहस्याशु नरप्रवीरो
रथं रथेनाधिरथेर्जगाम ।
भये तेषां त्राणमिच्छन्सुबाहु-
रभ्याहतानां रथयूथपेन ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty hero among men laughed, and swiftly drove his chariot toward the son of Adhiratha, wishing to save those struck down by Karna, the leader of chariot troops, in their fear.

verses.text:
विस्फार्य गाण्डीवमथोग्रघोषं
ज्यया समाहत्य तले भृशं च ।
बाणान्धकारं सहसैव कृत्वा
जघान नागाश्वरथान्नरांश्च ॥

meaning.en: Drawing the Gandiva with a fearsome sound, and striking the bowstring hard with his palm, he suddenly made a darkness of arrows and killed elephants, horses, chariots and men.

verses.text:
तं भीमसेनोऽनु ययौ रथेन
पृष्ठे रक्षन्पाण्डवमेकवीरम् ।
तौ राजपुत्रौ त्वरितौ रथाभ्यां
कर्णाय यातावरिभिर्विमुक्तौ ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena followed him in his chariot, guarding the back of the Pandava, a hero alone; the two princes, freed from their enemies, hurried in their chariots toward Karna.

verses.text:
अत्रान्तरे सुमहत्सूतपुत्र-
श्चक्रे युद्धं सोमकान्संप्रमृद्नन् ।
रथाश्वमातङ्गगणाञ्जघान
प्रच्छादयामास दिशः शरैश्च ॥

meaning.en: Meanwhile the charioteer's son fought a very great fight, crushing the Somakas, killing hosts of chariots, horses and elephants, and covering the quarters with arrows.

verses.text:
तमुत्तमौजा जनमेजयश्च
क्रुद्धौ युधामन्युशिखण्डिनौ च ।
कर्णं विनेदुः सहिताः पृषत्कैः
संमर्दमानाः सह पार्षतेन ॥

meaning.en: Uttamauja, Janamejaya, Yudhamanyu and Shikhandi, enraged, roared at Karna and pressed on him with arrows, along with Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.text:
ते पञ्च पाञ्चालरथाः सुरूपै-
र्वैकर्तनं कर्णमभिद्रवन्तः ।
तस्माद्रथाच्च्यावयितुं न शेकु-
र्धैर्यात्कृतात्मानमिवेन्द्रियाणि ॥

meaning.en: Those five Panchala chariot-warriors rushed on Vaikartana Karna with their splendid arrows but could not dislodge him from his chariot, as the senses cannot move a man of steady, disciplined self.

verses.text:
तेषां धनूंषि ध्वजवाजिसूतां-
स्तूणं पताकाश्च निकृत्य बाणैः ।
तान्पञ्चभिः स त्वहनत्पृषत्कैः
कर्णस्ततः सिंह इवोन्ननाद ॥

meaning.en: Karna cut away their bows, banners, horses, charioteers, quivers and flags with his arrows, struck the five with five arrows each, and roared like a lion.

verses.text:
तस्यास्यतस्तानभिनिघ्नतश्च
ज्याबाणहस्तस्य धनुःस्वनेन ।
साद्रिद्रुमा स्यात्पृथिवी विशीर्णा
इत्येव मत्वा जनता व्यषीदत् ॥

meaning.en: As he shot and struck them, the people, hearing the sound of his bow with the string and arrow in his hand, sank in despair, thinking that the earth with its mountains and trees would split apart.

verses.text:
स शक्रचापप्रतिमेन धन्वना
भृशाततेनाधिरथिः शरान्सृजन् ।
बभौ रणे दीप्तमरीचिमण्डलो
यथांशुमाली परिवेषवांस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Letting loose arrows from a bow that looked like Indra's rainbow, drawn hard, the son of Adhiratha shone in the battle with a circle of blazing rays, like the sun in its halo.

verses.text:
शिखण्डिनं द्वादशभिः पराभिन-
च्छितैः शरैः षड्भिरथोत्तमौजसम् ।
त्रिभिर्युधामन्युमविध्यदाशुगै-
स्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः सोमकपार्षतात्मजौ ॥

meaning.en: He pierced Shikhandi with twelve keen arrows and Uttamauja with six, Yudhamanyu with three swift arrows, and the sons of Soma and of Prishata with three each.

verses.text:
पराजिताः पञ्च महारथास्तु ते
महाहवे सूतसुतेन मारिष ।
निरुद्यमास्तस्थुरमित्रमर्दना
यथेन्द्रियार्थात्मवता पराजिताः ॥

meaning.en: Those five great chariot-warriors, O lord, crushers of foes, were defeated by the charioteer's son in that great battle and stood without effort, as men are overcome by a man who masters the sense objects.

verses.text:
निमज्जतस्तानथ कर्णसागरे
विपन्ननावो वणिजो यथार्णवे ।
उद्दध्रिरे नौभिरिवार्णवाद्रथैः
सुकल्पितैर्द्रौपदिजाः स्वमातुलान् ॥

meaning.en: As they sank in the sea of Karna, like merchants whose ships have been wrecked at sea, the sons of Draupadi, in well-prepared chariots like boats, rescued their maternal uncles from the ocean.

verses.text:
ततः शिनीनामृषभः शितैः शरै-
र्निकृत्य कर्णप्रहितानिषून्बहून् ।
विदार्य कर्णं निशितैरयस्मयै-
स्तवात्मजं ज्येष्ठमविध्यदष्टभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then the bull of the Sinis, Satyaki, cut down many arrows shot by Karna with his sharp shafts, and, splitting Karna with sharp iron arrows, pierced your eldest son Duryodhana with eight.

verses.text:
कृपोऽथ भोजश्च तवात्मजस्तथा
स्वयं च कर्णो निशितैरताडयत् ।
स तैश्चतुर्भिर्युयुधे यदूत्तमो
दिगीश्वरैर्दैत्यपतिर्यथा तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then Kripa, the Bhoja Kritavarman, your son and Karna himself struck him with sharp arrows; the best of the Yadavas fought those four, like the lord of the Daityas fighting the guardians of the quarters.

verses.text:
समानतेनेष्वसनेन कूजता
भृशाततेनामितबाणवर्षिणा ।
बभूव दुर्धर्षतरः स सात्यकिः
शरन्नभोमध्यगतो यथा रविः ॥

meaning.en: With his bow, twanging, drawn hard and showering endless arrows, Satyaki became very hard to approach, like the autumn sun at the middle of the sky.

verses.text:
पुनः समासाद्य रथान्सुदंशिताः
शिनिप्रवीरं जुगुपुः परंतपाः ।
समेत्य पाञ्चालरथा महारणे
मरुद्गणाः शक्रमिवारिनिग्रहे ॥

meaning.en: Once more the Panchala chariot-warriors, well armored, came together and protected the Sini hero, scorchers of foes, like the Maruts around Indra in the subduing of his enemies.

verses.text:
ततोऽभवद्युद्धमतीव दारुणं
तवाहितानां तव सैनिकैः सह ।
रथाश्वमातङ्गविनाशनं तथा
यथा सुराणामसुरैः पुराभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then a most dreadful fight began between your enemies and your soldiers, destroying chariots, horses and elephants, like the one between the gods and asuras long ago.

verses.text:
रथद्विपा वाजिपदातयोऽपि वा
भ्रमन्ति नानाविधशस्त्रवेष्टिताः ।
परस्परेणाभिहताश्च चस्खलु-
र्विनेदुरार्ता व्यसवोऽपतन्त च ॥

meaning.en: Chariots, elephants, horses and foot soldiers, wrapped in weapons of many sorts, reeled about, struck one another, slipped, cried out in pain and fell lifeless.

verses.text:
तथा गते भीममभीस्तवात्मजः
ससार राजावरजः किरञ्शरैः ।
तमभ्यधावत्त्वरितो वृकोदरो
महारुरुं सिंह इवाभिपेतिवान् ॥

meaning.en: In this state your fearless son, the king's younger brother Duhshasana, advanced on Bhima, showering arrows; Vrikodara hurried at him, like a lion attacking a great stag.

verses.text:
ततस्तयोर्युद्धमतीतमानुषं
प्रदीव्यतोः प्राणदुरोदरेऽभवत् ।
परस्परेणाभिनिविष्टरोषयो-
रुदग्रयोः शम्बरशक्रयोर्यथा ॥

meaning.en: Then the fight of those two, gambling with their lives, was beyond human, as both were filled with fixed rage and soaring pride, like Shambara and Indra.

verses.text:
शरैः शरीरान्तकरैः सुतेजनै-
र्निजघ्नतुस्तावितरेतरं भृशम् ।
सकृत्प्रभिन्नाविव वाशितान्तरे
महागजौ मन्मथसक्तचेतसौ ॥

meaning.en: They struck each other hard with sharp arrows that end bodies, like two great elephants in rut, passionate with desire, clashing in a herd of cows.

verses.text:
तवात्मजस्याथ वृकोदरस्त्वर-
न्धनुः क्षुराभ्यां ध्वजमेव चाच्छिनत् ।
ललाटमप्यस्य बिभेद पत्रिणा
शिरश्च कायात्प्रजहार सारथेः ॥

meaning.en: Then Vrikodara quickly cut your son's bow and banner with two razor-headed arrows, pierced his forehead with a feathered shaft, and struck the head of his charioteer from his body.

verses.text:
स राजपुत्रोऽन्यदवाप्य कार्मुकं
वृकोदरं द्वादशभिः पराभिनत् ।
स्वयं नियच्छंस्तुरगानजिह्मगैः
शरैश्च भीमं पुनरभ्यवीवृषत् ॥

meaning.en: That prince took another bow and pierced Vrikodara with twelve arrows; controlling the horses himself, he again showered Bhima with straight-flying arrows.
